info.title: SCD Wellness — Mobile App API
info.description: REST API for the SCD Wellness Flutter app. Two roles: **patient** (mobile) and **doctor** (web dashboard). Protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

post.summary: Sign in with Google (Firebase) / Apple / Facebook
post.description:
Unified social login endpoint. Provider-specific notes:

**firebase** — Send the Firebase ID token from the Firebase Auth SDK.
Token is a signed JWT; backend verifies signature + project ID.
`first_name` / `last_name` are read from the token automatically.

**apple** — Send the `identityToken` from the `sign_in_with_apple` Flutter package.
Apple does NOT include the user's name in the token; it is only available
on the very first sign-in. Pass `first_name` and `last_name` separately on
first login — on subsequent logins they can be omitted.

**google / facebook** — Send the OAuth `accessToken` from the provider SDK.
Backend verifies via Laravel Socialite.

first_name.description: Apple only — required on first sign-in

last_name.description: Apple only — required on first sign-in

200.description: OTP sent (always returns success to prevent email enumeration)

get.summary: Health dashboard data — condition card, risk level, signals, and 7-day bar chart in one call
get.description:
Single endpoint that powers the entire health dashboard screen.

**calibration_status:**
- `calibrating` — <28 days of data. `latest_score` is null. Show 'Calibrating...' state.
- `active` — baseline live. All fields populated.
- `stale` — no band readings for >12 hours. Show 'No band data' warning.

**latest_score.status → Condition card colour:**
- `stable` → Green
- `watch` → Yellow
- `elevated` → Amber
- `urgent` → Red

**Condition percentage:** compute client-side → `(total_score / 15 * 100).clamp(0, 100)`

**outreach_recommended: true** → show 'Contact your care team' banner.

**signals** → individual z-scores for O2/Temp/HR labels in the Risk Level card:
- z between -1 and 1 → 'Normal'
- z between 1 and 2 → 'Watch'
- z > 2 → 'High' / z < -2 → 'Low'

**score_history** → 7-day bar chart. One entry per day (latest score that day). Days with no data are omitted — handle sparse arrays.

Poll on app foreground or every 30 minutes — the engine runs every 30 min.

status.description: Drives the condition card colour and Overall Risk Level badge

outreach_recommended.description: true → show Contact care team banner

outreach_reason.example: SpO2 ≥2.5 SD below personal baseline for ≥30 consecutive minutes

signals.description: Per-signal z-scores. Use for O2/Temp/HR Normal labels. |z|<1=Normal, 1-2=Watch, >2=High/Low

baselines.description: Patient's personal rolling mean and stddev per signal

score_history.description: Last 7 days — one entry per day for the bar chart. Oldest first. Days with no data omitted.

get.summary: Get daily health score history — use for the 7-day bar chart
get.description: Returns one score entry per calendar day (the latest score that day). Default is 7 days. Use the `days` query param for a different range (max 30).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days to return (1–30). Default 7.

history.description: One entry per day, oldest first. Days with no score are omitted (patient was calibrating or band was offline).

status.description: Use this to colour each bar

get.description: Returns whether the user has an active subscription. Poll this on app open to gate features. Tester accounts always return `subscribed: true`.
Returns list of past subscription payments (invoices), newest first.

post.description: Cancels the active Paystack subscription. The user retains access until `expires_at`. No request body needed.

Generates a short-lived token (15 min) and returns a `subscribe_url`. Open this URL in an in-app browser or external browser — the website will use it to identify the user and show the Paystack payment page. No request body needed.

get.description: Returns all of the user's health data as JSON — vitals, medications, symptoms, risk scores. **Always accessible regardless of subscription status** — even after cancellation.
